# Project Guidelines

## Flow Builder parity agreement

- The frozen source of truth is [PARITY_SCOPE_FREEZE.md](../PARITY_SCOPE_FREEZE.md). Delivery sequencing is recorded in [PARITY_PHASE_PLAN.md](../PARITY_PHASE_PLAN.md); it does not change acceptance criteria. Do not relist, renegotiate, or expand the frozen scope unless the user explicitly asks.
- The agreed exclusions are Apex code/Apex-based custom Flow actions and custom Lightning-component (LWC) screen components/Lightning-component-based Flow UI. Standard Salesforce-provided components and first-party actions remain in scope.
- Say “100% done” only when every in-scope checklist item has been implemented and verified. Otherwise, continue the work; if genuinely blocked, state the specific blocker and why it cannot be resolved.
- Do not repeatedly qualify the completion goal or stop after each fix to ask whether to continue. Continue through the pending in-scope work and report concise, evidence-based progress.
